summary.text: Molly Howard is a Democratic state representative from Hillsborough 31 who is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election; she faces Republican Jarvis Adams.
She previously served in the House from 2022 to 2024.

paragraphs.text: Molly Howard was born in Alaska.

Her career experience includes working as an administrative coordinator with the Dartmouth College Thayer School of Engineering, a senior associate with NBBJ, and an associate with Chan Krieger Sieniewicz.
Howard represented Hillsborough 31 in the New Hampshire House from 2022 to 2024 and assumed her current seat on December 18, 2024.
In the 2023-2024 session she was assigned to the Environment and Agriculture Committee.
